capabilities: Roll dice inline with arithmetic, keep/drop, explode, reroll and counting notation
Roll on random note sections, table rows, list items and tagged notes
Animate dice throws in a sidebar or window
Log rolls into a session note
Expose a roll API for other plugins
extras: Free and MIT-licensed, uses no network and collects nothing. Dice throws are capped at 20 dice and respect reduced-motion settings. The same maker sells DM Screen ($12) and a Mapsmith Pro save ($6); Dice Tray itself stays free.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to roll dice or pick random table, note or tag results inside a game-session note.

relations.evidence: It reads the same notation as the Dice Roller plugin's dice: blocks
With Session Log installed, a roll you click lands in your session log
DM Screen, from the same maker, shows the rolls you click on your players' phones.

summary: Dice roller that renders inline rolls using advanced dice notation, rolls on random tables, notes and tags, and shows animated dice.
